status: canonical possibility-collapse validation matrix; classic emergence, pseudo-emergence, public MARL and capability-emergence rows in one schema; evidence tiers separate ground truth from convergent validity
definition: emergence as endogenous collapse / reorganization and stabilization of a reachable possibility space; macro structure is a product/projection, not the definition itself

rows.name: Kuramoto supercritical
rows.possibility_space: relative phase futures collapse to the synchrony manifold
rows.evidence_route: D>=0.5 and R>=0.6 under frozen held-out thresholds

rows.name: Boids high coupling
rows.possibility_space: heading futures collapse from many directions to a flock manifold
rows.evidence_route: coupling-monotone entropy contraction, TC growth, do-decouple JS

rows.name: Schelling high tolerance
rows.possibility_space: spatial configuration futures collapse to segregated basins
rows.expected_status: structural weak emergence, often negative value

rows.name: Game-of-Life glider
rows.possibility_space: counterfactual perturbation ensemble around a deterministic travelling orbit; fixed exact microstate has zero uncertainty
rows.evidence_route: held-out Life glider accepted by D/R under perturbation/decoupling; stored test does not by itself measure pre/post stochastic collapse
rows.boundary_note: exact-state contract: deterministic, C=0; perturbation-ensemble contract: D/R weak emergence

rows.name: Ant double-bridge trail
rows.possibility_space: route-choice futures collapse from two open routes to one trail
rows.evidence_route: D/R pass and collapse is gradual, not abrupt

rows.name: Ant solo obstacle navigation
rows.possibility_space: individual route choice, no collective joint-branch constraint
rows.evidence_route: no coupling to break; C/D/R all zero
